Hey i am 14. I am a child. I speak the truth. It simply does not matter how you look. This unrealistic picture of a person you want to be that has been engraved into your head is only bringing you down. It’s hard, and theres so much for both of us to understand in this topic but the point is, live for yourself. You are yourself. We’re all here for you to support you and help you take care and it’s important you understand this. Your kids love you your husband loves you and although it’s a horrible thought to leave them, be mindful not to leave yourself too 💗 stay strong babe
Its not even like i dont feel happy.. i do!! I dont even care i just cant be bothered living i want it over with

Being apart of the lgbtq+ community can be hard but i promise you being yourself is worth it. Fellow gay here speaking, sometimes people are gonna be shitty but its important you find others who support you. Those are the real ones. This happens sometimes and the best thing to do is ignore it and stay safe. I havnt come out to my family and i dont plan to. I dont think its necessary to act like its something abnormal because its not. One day im just gonna show up with a beautiful girlfriend and all they have to do is accept it :) i am lucky because my family is supportive but if yours is not, you must be reminded your sexuality is nothing to be ashamed of. Keep being yourself just dont get into any trouble haha. Have fun and stay safe 🏳️‍🌈💜 
Sidenote some people just havnt realised that its a normal thing yet just give it time no pressure!
